description: Persons: our staff and the outside contacts who wrote to them, from the mail capture (ontology/people_directory.py), with the messages, meetings, Teams posts, Planner tasks and Mission Control work they take part in (ontology/people_links.py). Every Person value is pii-marked. Portal users (app_user) stay pending until the reporting API serves them.

object_types.description: A person the mail capture knows: one of our staff (one per captured mailbox: its Entra object id, UPN and addresses) or an outside contact who wrote to a captured mailbox (one per sender address that is not ours and no automated sender), ontology/people_directory.py. An excluded person is never a Person: without a usable exclusion list there is none at all, a mailbox naming an excluded person is none, and an address at our own domains that no captured mailbox holds is withheld. A staff person is seen by readers of their own mailbox; an outside contact by readers of the one mailbox holding most of their mail. Portal users (app_user) stay pending in ontology/schema/pending/people_lots.json. BC contacts stay the Contact type.

bindings.note: One object per staff mailbox (key: its Entra object id) and per outside sender address (key: the sha256 of the lower-case address, as the capture's priority_senders census keys it); cited graph-mail://<audience mailbox>/person/<key>.

properties.name: kind
properties.description: staff: one of ours (a captured mailbox); outside: a contact who wrote to one.

properties.name: object_id
properties.description: A staff person's Entra object id (null for an outside contact).

properties.name: upn
properties.description: A staff person's user principal name (null for an outside contact).

properties.name: addresses
properties.description: Every mail address of the person, lower case: a staff person's UPN and SMTP identities, an outside contact's one sender address.

properties.name: domain
properties.description: The mail domain of the UPN (staff) or the sender address (outside).

object_types.description: A Portal user (not the Person type: our staff and outside contacts from the mail capture): an employee (ADMIN .. ACCOUNTING roles) or a customer/supplier portal login (CUSTOMER, SUPPLIER). Bindings and links are declared and tested in ontology/schema/pending/people_lots.json, which replaces this placeholder when loaded with include_pending. BC contacts stay the Contact type.

availability.reason: Pending: the reporting-API allowlist (services/workbench-api/manifest/allowlist.json@790256ca43) does not serve public.app_user (nor app_person/people): Portal users are not readable, so a person appears only as an id or a name typed in another record.

prisma.user.note: User -> app_user: unique email, name/firstName/lastName, phone, jobTitle, userRole UserRole, departmentId, isActive, Entra ids, password/2FA/reset secrets.

wb.people_directory.note: Staff from the mail capture's mailboxes table, outside contacts from the current messages' sender addresses; the people exclusion decides first and fails closed.

wb.people_links.note: Post-project step: exact address / Entra object id / staff local-part matches to the projected Person records.

link_types.name: sent_by_person
link_types.description: The Person whose address is the message's sender, corroborated. Exact matches only; never to a withheld or excluded person (none is a Person). Also a recorded human review.

link_types.name: addressed_to_person
link_types.description: Each Person whose address is among the message's To or Cc addresses, corroborated. Exact matches only; never to a withheld or excluded person (none is a Person). Also a recorded human review.

link_types.name: with_person

link_types.name: with_person
link_types.description: The staff Person a task's assignee or accountable owner names: a bare name that is exactly the local part of one staff person's address at our own domains (and of no other's), corroborated. Exact matches only; never to a withheld or excluded person (none is a Person). Also a recorded human review.
